_key.description: Motif key and Ensembl protein ID joined by an underscore.

_from.description: Document handle of the motif, whose key is the transcription factor name followed by _SEMpl.

_to.description: Document handle of the transcription factor protein the motif models binding for.

name.description: Predicate describing the relationship in the _from to _to direction: the motif is used by this protein.

inverse_name.description: Predicate describing the same relationship in the _to to _from direction: the protein uses this motif.

biological_process.description: Gene Ontology term for the process this edge represents, as a handle into ontology_terms. GO_0003677 is 'DNA binding'.

source.description: The dataset this edge was loaded from.

source_url.description: Link to the IGVF model file this edge was derived from.

class.description: Evidence tier for the underlying data, taken from the file's fileset metadata: 'observed data' for a direct experimental measurement.

method.description: Model or pipeline that produced this record, taken from the file's fileset metadata.

files_filesets.description: Handle of the files_filesets record for the IGVF file this record was read from.

accessible_via.return: _id, name, inverse_name, biological_process, source, source_url, class, method, files_filesets
